title: Medical & Rating Expiry Countdown
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry event=certificate
| eval days_to=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where days_to<120
| sort days_to
| table certificate days_to
description: Counts down to the expiry of your medical, ratings, and flight review so none lapses unnoticed.
value: A lapsed medical or review grounds you; an early countdown gives time to book renewals without a gap.
implementation: Log certificate expiry dates into `index=personal`; alert as each approaches expiry.
visualization: Table of pilot certificates by days to expiry.
grandmaExplanation: It counts down to when your pilot medical and ratings expire, so none lapses and grounds you.
